label: Exact CDF reuse
idea: Different branches can have exactly the same opponent hand distribution. Compute their cumulative probabilities once and share them.
detail: All 169 values must match bit for bit before reuse.

label: Active terminal queue
idea: Build a GPU list of positive-probability branches once per traverser, then schedule only that list for later particle batches.
detail: The original first batch still clears zero branches. Sample order, solver updates and numerical results must stay identical.

label: No-tie product reuse
idea: When a warp has no tie mass, compute its identical quadrature products once.
detail: Every particle and weighted addition keeps its original order. Other cases use the full tie calculation.

label: Lossless CDF compression
idea: Store repeated cumulative probabilities once during learning, then decode their exact original values.
detail: Accuracy checks keep the existing format. Direct prefix and full solver comparisons must match bit for bit before timing.

label: GPU time breakdown
idea: Measure how much time the retained version spends constructing cumulative probabilities, evaluating terminals and updating the game.
detail: Diagnostic timers must preserve solver answers. Eager timings explain the workload; they do not count as a speed gain.

label: Aligned probability writes
idea: Align the first cumulative-probability write in every row so a warp writes into fewer memory sectors.
detail: Only storage addresses change. All probability values, direct reads, samples and solver arithmetic remain identical; extra memory and startup count.

label: Cross-player probability reuse
idea: Measure identical probability distributions shared across players during accuracy checks.
detail: Read-only inventory checks exact identity and the full GPU memory cost before admitting a prototype. No measured speed gain yet.

label: Wider player groups
idea: Measure shared probability work across groups of three or four players during accuracy checks.
detail: Enumerate every grouping and its full memory cost. Select groups from the game tree, without fitting them to a particular learned strategy. Inventory only.

label: Shared accuracy-check tables
idea: Build identical cumulative probability tables once for each group of players during accuracy checks.
detail: Exact numerical results and allocation verified, but the complete large run was 41.1% slower. Rejected prototype archived and removed; no deployment.

label: Smaller shared check groups
idea: Share probability tables among at most three players, with more GPU memory headroom.
detail: Retained after three large and three small paired comparisons: 7.7% less large complete time, exact outputs and all regressions passed. Uses more GPU memory; research only, not deployed.

label: Where shared checks spend time
idea: Measure remaining work in the retained shared-check implementation.
detail: Separate probability construction, terminal evaluation and buffer restoration. Diagnostic timers must preserve every solver result.

label: Cooperative terminal reads
idea: Load each opponent probability row once into shared GPU memory during terminal calculations.
detail: Rejected: the first large complete run was 22.6% slower despite exact solver outputs. Archived and removed; C07 remains retained. No deployment.

label: Partial terminal loop unrolling
idea: Ask the GPU compiler to process two consecutive terminal samples per loop step, keeping the original addition order.
detail: Retained: 4.2% less large complete time versus C07 across three alternating pairs; all exact comparisons and regressions pass. Small complete median +1.8%, within the registered limit. Research only.

label: Factor-four terminal unrolling
idea: Compare four consecutive terminal samples per loop step against the retained factor-two version.
detail: Rejected: exact results, but only 1.47% median large gain across three pairs, below the 3% gate. C09 restored; no deployment.

label: Terminal L1-cache preference
idea: Ask the driver to favor L1 cache for the retained terminal kernels, with identical compiled calculations.
detail: Rejected: the first large complete run was 16.8% slower despite identical PTX and solver outputs. Cache preference removed; C09 remains retained.

label: Terminal data-locality inventory
idea: Check whether one fixed terminal ordering improves probability-row reuse before attempting a GPU prototype.
detail: Rejected before a GPU prototype: the fixed ordering produced 2.80-2.82 times as many simulated large-fixture cache misses. Independent witness checks matched. Retained GPU code is unchanged.

label: Predicated probability scan
idea: Use the existing GPU lane-valid flag to avoid an extra selection at each probability scan step.
detail: Rejected: exact probability tables and solver outputs, but only 0.16% less complete-run time, below the first-pair screen. Candidate archived and removed; C09 restored.

label: Hardware bottleneck profiling
idea: Measure GPU throughput and stalls before choosing the next kernel change.
detail: Counter access denied; no driver settings changed. Independent disassembly audit shows the compiler had already removed most of C12's apparent selection overhead. Diagnostic only; C09 remains retained.

label: Safe selection and saved-game qualification
idea: Use the best retained GPU path when memory permits and preserve the normal GPU path otherwise.
detail: Opt-in memory selection qualified: all four paths match on both saved fixtures, including save/reload continuation; 19 GPU and 181 default regressions pass. Partial-allocation failure and production integration remain. No deployment or new speed claim.

label: Bounded 32-bit element indices
idea: Reduce terminal address calculations while retaining wide byte pointers and all floating-point operations.
detail: Rejected: 6.30% less large complete time, but 3.67% more small complete time exceeds the 3% limit. All outputs exact; duplicate module startup offsets faster kernels on small games. Candidate archived and C09 restored. C14 will test direct construction.

label: Direct construction of narrowed kernels
idea: Keep bounded element-index arithmetic while removing duplicate module startup.
detail: Retained: 6.44% less large complete time and 5.33% less small complete time across three alternating pairs each. Exact solver results, unchanged allocations, 19 GPU and 181 default regressions passed. Direct construction removes the C13 startup regression. Not deployed.

label: Partial GPU allocation recovery
idea: Verify real allocation failure after partial optimized construction recovers cleanly.
detail: Qualified: real CUDA allocation failures after partial construction recover through the normal GPU engine, with exact results and zero remaining pool-used bytes after shutdown; optimized retry succeeds for wide and narrow kernels. Initial WDDM capacity assumption failed and is archived. Test-only change; no deployment.

label: Normal GPU server integration
idea: Make retained optimizations available in the regular server with automatic memory-aware fallback.
detail: Deployed to 56708 on 14 September 2026 after explicit user authorization. Qualified R03 v3 binary hash verified; preflop iteration 16 and postflop 210 restored with exact root strategies, settings, profiles, locks and library inventory. Backups and rollback binary preserved. Compact-table experiment excluded.

label: CDF writer address screen
idea: Narrow bounded CDF writer element indices while preserving wide byte pointers and exact scan arithmetic.
detail: Rejected before timing: 252 exact writer cases and 48 wide-byte address witnesses pass, but registers increase 26 to 30 and integer address PTX operations 69 to 84. All other 19 kernel entries unchanged. No runtime selection change; C16 fusion proposed next.

label: Fused local probability tables
idea: Build rank-CDFs inside terminal blocks to avoid global scratch traffic, preserving exact prefix and terminal arithmetic.
detail: Rejected: first complete large pair is 44.08% slower (53.256s to 76.731s), despite 672 exact prefix/hand-value cases, six expanded solver tests and exact full-arena checkpoints. Allocations unchanged. No extended campaign; candidate archived and removed, retained runtime restored. Port 56708 unchanged.

label: Bounded terminal tile inventory
idea: Share exact probability tables within contiguous terminal tiles before considering a cache-sized GPU prototype.
detail: Rejected by storage gate: 128-terminal tiles add 11.7% learning / 4.1% check table work, but check tables reach 6.56 MiB against a 4 MiB budget. That schedule also needs 1.55M learning and 1.41M check producer/consumer launches. Larger tiles exceed storage further. Both immutable fixtures and independent witnesses verified; no runtime or production change.

label: Four terminal warps per block
idea: Assign one independent warp per terminal, preserving probability tables and per-hand arithmetic.
detail: Rejected: first complete large pair is 167.39% slower, despite 4,032 exact kernel cases and six expanded solver tests. Only terminal scheduling changed; global allocations and all solver checkpoints match C14. No extended campaign; candidate archived and removed. Retained runtime and port 56708 unchanged.

label: Retained GPU cost and work-volume audit
idea: Refresh phase timings and quantify the remaining arithmetic and table work before choosing another optimization.
detail: Verified: retained large learning spends 49% in probability tables and 47% in multiway evaluation; checks spend 40% and 59%. Exact saved outputs and independent work census pass. One-stage optimizations cannot approach 10x overall; next screen targets repeated partial products. Diagnostic only; runtime and 56708 unchanged.

label: Exact partial-product cache inventory
idea: Reuse ordered first-two-opponent products across branches with a fixed bounded cache.
detail: Rejected before GPU implementation: optimistic large learning/check arithmetic savings are 3.64%/2.97%, and logical terminal traffic savings 1.70%/1.30%, below registered 20%/10% gates. Independent pair decoders and immutable record accounting pass. No new speed point; runtime and 56708 unchanged.

label: Exact sampled-rank reuse inventory
idea: Measure products shared by hand classes with identical sampled rank boundaries.
detail: Admitted for a separate prototype: 169 classes average 57.19 exact rank groups per sample. Compact products could remove 56% of large terminal source arithmetic; warp-local sharing 33%. Independent static table and work-count verification pass. Coordination costs excluded; no measured speed gain or deployment.

label: Compact equal-rank products
idea: Compute identical sampled-rank products once, preserving each hand accumulation order.
detail: Rejected: corrected compact-rank kernel is 43.67% slower on the complete large pair (53.130s to 76.331s). 5,040 exact kernel cases, eight solver tests and both allocation audits pass; all saved checkpoints match. Warm learning +29%, checks +60%. Candidate removed; retained runtime and 56708 unchanged.

label: Warp-local rank sharing execution screen
idea: Check whether fewer active lanes remove original warp work or distinct probability-table sectors.
detail: Declined before GPU implementation: all 6,144 sample/warp cases retain the same original arithmetic paths and load-sector sets across eight base alignments. D13's lane savings remain valid, but modeled warp work and sector savings are zero. Independent election and bit-vector checks pass. No timing claim; runtime and 56708 unchanged.

label: Interleaved probability scan tiles
idea: Expose six independent prefix-scan chains while preserving the original carry order.
detail: Rejected: complete large run 53.193s to 53.049s, only 0.27% faster, below the 1% screen. Nine solver tests, 672 prefix cases, both memory inventories and all saved checkpoints match. A first-evaluation test expectation was corrected without changing the kernel. Integration removed; retained runtime and 56708 unchanged.

label: Empty probability-scan tile bound
idea: Check whether exact zeros can eliminate complete prefix-scan chains in both learning and checks.
detail: Both-mode proposal rejected: every large averaged distribution has all 169 classes positive, so check empty-tile savings are exactly zero. Learning's optimistic bound is 78.88%, not an actual count. Independent support/capacity/cohort audits pass. Learning-only dispatch needs a separate screen; no speed gain or deployment.

label: Learning-only conservative empty-tile bound
idea: Prove a minimum empty-tile fraction from support counts before changing a GPU kernel.
detail: Lower-bound gate failed: guaranteed empty fractions are 13.41% small and 8.97% large, below 20%. This does not determine actual occupancy; D17 separately extracts actual support masks. No runtime or production change.

label: Actual learning scan-tile occupancy
idea: Measure exact empty tiles over every fixed sample and distinct learning distribution.
detail: GPU prototype admitted: actual empty learning tiles are 39.97% small and 33.64% large. Two independent intersection methods agree; D10 witnesses and all learning arenas match exactly. Loads, votes, carry and stores remain. No measured speed gain or deployment.

label: Learning-only exact-zero scan bypass
idea: Use a warp-wide zero vote to bypass empty tile arithmetic while keeping the check writer intact.
detail: Rejected at compiler screen: 1,008 exact GPU cases pass, all 20 original kernel entries unchanged, but sparse writer static PTX grows 324 to 408 instructions (+25.93%) against a 20% limit. Six real scan bypasses; no spills or register growth. No complete-work timing or speed claim.

label: Sparse scan with shuffle-valid additions
idea: Reduce nonempty branch overhead while bypassing exact-zero learning tiles.
detail: Rejected: complete large run 53.159s to 53.631s, 0.89% slower. 1,008 exact prefix cases, nine solver tests, unchanged allocations and all saved checkpoints pass. Learning-only dispatch verified; checks use original kernel. Integration removed. No speed gain or deployment.

label: Two-kernel rank-product pipeline
idea: Share exact rank products across hands using bounded global scratch and separate producer/consumer kernels.
detail: GPU prototype admitted: large modeled arithmetic falls 56% and logical terminal traffic 16-17%, after scratch transfers. Extra memory 834 MiB; 18,688 additional launches per sweep/check remain a risk. Independent binary and rank audits pass. No measured speed gain or deployment.

label: Separate rank-product kernels
idea: Replace per-sample shared-memory barriers with bounded global scratch and ordered producer/consumer launches.
detail: Rejected: complete large workload 53.237s to 108.862s, 104.49% slower. Nine solver tests, exact saved checkpoints and both planned allocations pass. Warm learning +91%, checks +132%. Runtime integration removed; retained R03 and 56708 unchanged.

label: Static rank-boundary probability tables
idea: Store only the original cumulative prefixes read by the fixed rank groups, with direct static addresses.
detail: GPU prototype admitted: declared CDF storage falls 60.29%, logical stores 65.77%. All 173,056 hand boundaries and 32,272 windows verified. Large final allocation 11.75 GB; old/new overlap exceeds budget and needs private fresh construction. No GPU timing or deployment.

label: Static boundary CDF writer and reader
idea: Store only rank-boundary prefixes with direct static addresses while preserving all scan arithmetic.
detail: Retained research improvement: median 13.95% less large-game and 5.03% less small-game runtime across six exact pairs. Ten integrated numerical/save/stop/recovery tests, 20 native GPU tests and 181 default tests passed. Normal app integration and qualification remain next; R03 stays live on 56708.
